title: Secret Origins #11 DC 1987 Golden Age Hawkman Power Girl Jerry Ordway Cover
condition_description: Reading copy: piece torn from the bottom right corner of the front cover, creasing and edge chipping; back cover toned with chipping and staining along the edges. See photos.
description:
Secret Origins #11 (February 1987), DC Comics - origins of the Golden Age Hawkman (Roy Thomas and Luke McDonnell) and Power Girl (Paul Kupperberg and Mary Wilshire). Cover by Jerry Ordway. $1.25 cover price.

Back cover: Monogram Tornado R/C dune buggy ad.

Condition: reading copy. A piece is torn from the bottom right corner of the front cover, with creasing and chipping along the edges; the back cover is toned with chipping and staining along the edges (see close-up photos). Interior intact.

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
